title: P3: achieved per-cycle containment != job_object must STOP, not merely record (M0-T053 R4 half)
objective: QUALIFYING EVIDENCE (AD-093 demonstrated security risk): M0-T053 G5 R4 enforcement half + M0-T036-ACTIVATION-CHECKLIST P3. M0-T053 enforces criterion (1) of the 2026-08-08 pin (host DEFAULT containment) but criterion (2) - the ACHIEVED per-cycle containment - is still only RECORDED on RunResult.containment / the claude_process_started transition. ProcessContainer.adopt can degrade honestly to taskkill at launch time; a cycle whose run_result.containment != 'job_object' must PAUSE/STOP, because unattended nobody reads the audit line. SCOPE (smallest durable set): make an achieved-containment != 'job_object' outcome a fail-closed STOP of the supervised cycle with an explicit recorded reason, not merely an audit line. Correct nothing else (supervisor-freeze; do NOT change loop behaviour beyond this stop). REQUIRED TESTS: a cycle reporting containment=job_object proceeds; a cycle reporting a degraded containment STOPS with the recorded reason; full supervisor suite re-establishes the M0-T039 baseline (>=1165, 0 failures) plus the new tests.
business_reason: P3 is a required pre-M0-T056 correction: unattended, a per-cycle containment degradation must halt rather than be silently recorded, since no operator reads the audit line under actuation.
forbidden_paths: tools/agent_supervisor/** modules not named in allowed_paths (smallest durable set only; wider need = STOP-and-report at G0)
Any redesign or speculative supervisor feature (supervisor-freeze; defect-only)
acceptance_scenarios: P3-SC1 a cycle reporting run_result.containment == 'job_object' proceeds normally.
P3-SC2 a cycle reporting a degraded/non-job_object achieved containment STOPS with an explicit recorded reason (does not merely audit and continue).
P3-SC3 freeze baseline: full supervisor suite re-establishes M0-T039 (>=1165, 0 failures) + new tests; non-vacuity shown.
risks: PRODUCER MUST CONFIRM EXACT FILES AT G0: the achieved-containment STOP touches wherever RunResult.containment is evaluated post-run (loop.py likely; claude_runner.py produces it; state_machine.py holds the claude_process_started transition). Narrow to the smallest set; STOP-and-report if a different file is required.
Depends on M0-T058 (P1): both may touch claude_runner.py — sequence after P1.
Supervisor-freeze: do NOT change loop behaviour beyond this single fail-closed stop; re-establish the M0-T039 baseline.
